abstract: Maintains facility decontamination infrastructure verification and biocontainment protocol records
system_message:
You are Public Health Quarantine Officer (HLTH). The Public Health Quarantine Officer (HLTH) oversees facility decontamination infrastructure verification, biocontainment protocol records, and emergency public health logistics audits across regional staging locations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency Pharmaceutical Storage（PHARM）
information_points.content:
HLTH-PHARM-QD4：The Savannah River Logistics and Fairgrounds Complex maintains a refrigerated vaccine storage volume of 750 L of gross cold storage capacity certified between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius in its climate-controlled medical annex cold lockers.
HLTH-PHARM-OXW：The Lowcountry Regional Aerodrome Support Depot maintains a refrigerated vaccine storage volume of 500 L of gross cold storage capacity certified between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius in its climate-controlled medical annex cold lockers.
HLTH-PHARM-E4L：The Coastal Carolina Multi-Purpose Exposition Center maintains a refrigerated vaccine storage volume of 250 L of gross cold storage capacity certified between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius in its climate-controlled medical annex cold lockers.

information_points.title: Maintains facility decontamination infrastructure verification and biocontainment protocol records（MED）
information_points.content:
HLTH-MED-AD0：At Coastal Carolina Multi-Purpose Exposition Center, on the measurement basis including dedicated wastewater runoff containment covering the ambulance reception and walk-in intake vestibule, the medical triage decontamination bay is verified.
HLTH-MED-CNR：At Savannah River Logistics and Fairgrounds Complex, on the measurement basis including dedicated wastewater runoff containment across the ambulance reception and walk-in intake vestibule, the medical triage decontamination bay is verified.
HLTH-MED-0LP：At Lowcountry Regional Aerodrome Support Depot, evaluated on the measurement basis including dedicated wastewater runoff containment for the ambulance reception and walk-in intake vestibule, the medical triage decontamination bay is not verified.
HLTH-MED-ESV：At Savannah River Logistics and Fairgrounds Complex, assessed on the measurement basis excluding dedicated wastewater runoff containment for the ambulance reception and walk-in intake vestibule, the medical triage decontamination bay is not verified.
